problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate cargo space across ten distinct shipping routes, each requiring ten sequential handling stages before dispatch.  
The revenue generated per metric ton of cargo on each route is listed below:  
* For Route Alpha, revenue is 18.65 per metric ton  
* For Route Beta, revenue is 18.879 per metric ton  
* For Route Gamma, revenue is 18.003 per metric ton  
* For Route Delta, revenue is 7.981 per metric ton  
* For Route Epsilon, revenue is 14.078 per metric ton  
* For Route Zeta, revenue is 12.979 per metric ton  
* For Route Eta, revenue is 5.768 per metric ton  
* For Route Theta, revenue is 8.45 per metric ton  
* For Route Iota, revenue is 13.585 per metric ton  
* For Route Kappa, revenue is 17.883 per metric ton  

The handling duration per metric ton for each stage is as follows:  
*For Route Alpha, Stage 1 requires 1.559 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 1.662 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 1.019 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 1.917 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 1.3 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 0.702 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 0.796 (ton-hours), Stage 8 requires 0.874 (ton-hours), Stage 9 requires 0.435 (ton-hours), Stage 10 requires 1.358 (ton-hours)  
*For Route Beta, Stage 1 requires 1.166 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 1.682 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 0.375 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 0.476 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 0.808 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 0.59 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 0.652 (ton-hours), Stage 8 requires 0.834 (ton-hours), Stage 9 requires 0.837 (ton-hours), Stage 10 requires 1.114 (ton-hours)  
*For Route Gamma, Stage 1 requires 1.531 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 1.135 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 1.804 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 0.314 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 1.381 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 1.39 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 1.878 (ton-hours), Stage 8 requires 1.236 (ton-hours), Stage 9 requires 1.479 (ton-hours), Stage 10 requires 1.027 (ton-hours)  
*For Route Delta, Stage 1 requires 0.333 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 0.379 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 1.02 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 1.329 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 0.887 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 0.532 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 1.762 (ton-hours), Stage 8 requires 1.925 (ton-hours), Stage 9 requires 0.82 (ton-hours), Stage 10 requires 0.701 (ton-hours)  
*For Route Epsilon, Stage 1 requires 0.454 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 1.953 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 1.22 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 1.183 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 0.764 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 1.641 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 0.539 (ton-hours), Stage 8 requires 1.399 (ton-hours), Stage 9 requires 1.406 (ton-hours), Stage 10 requires 1.885 (ton-hours)  
*For Route Zeta, Stage 1 requires 1.7 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 1.0 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 1.502 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 1.113 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 0.446 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 1.172 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 1.495 (ton-hours), Stage 8 requires 1.869 (ton-hours), Stage 9 requires 1.2 (ton-hours), Stage 10 requires 0.677 (ton-hours)  
*For Route Eta, Stage 1 requires 1.124 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 1.451 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 0.712 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 0.437 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 0.547 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 0.741 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 0.573 (ton-hours), Stage 8 requires 0.73 (ton-hours), Stage 9 requires 0.276 (ton-hours), Stage 10 requires 0.985 (ton-hours)  
*For Route Theta, Stage 1 requires 1.444 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 0.219 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 0.5 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 0.386 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 0.954 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 1.774 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 0.684 (ton-hours), Stage 8 requires 0.923 (ton-hours), Stage 9 requires 0.837 (ton-hours), Stage 10 requires 0.479 (ton-hours)  
*For Route Iota, Stage 1 requires 0.364 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 0.587 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 0.276 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 0.908 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 1.568 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 0.701 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 1.981 (ton-hours), Stage 8 requires 1.107 (ton-hours), Stage 9 requires 1.561 (ton-hours), Stage 10 requires 1.222 (ton-hours)  
*For Route Kappa, Stage 1 requires 1.222 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 1.607 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 1.612 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 0.57 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 0.489 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 0.532 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 0.617 (ton-hours), Stage 8 requires 0.341 (ton-hours), Stage 9 requires 0.617 (ton-hours), Stage 10 requires 0.915 (ton-hours)  

The cumulative handling duration allocated to each stage cannot surpass its available capacity:  
* Stage 1’s total handling duration must not exceed 167.651 hours  
* Stage 2’s total handling duration must not exceed 216.01 hours  
* Stage 3’s total handling duration must not exceed 183.249 hours  
* Stage 4’s total handling duration must not exceed 151.531 hours  
* Stage 5’s total handling duration must not exceed 131.146 hours  
* Stage 6’s total handling duration must not exceed 145.805 hours  
* Stage 7’s total handling duration must not exceed 230.315 hours  
* Stage 8’s total handling duration must not exceed 246.171 hours  
* Stage 9’s total handling duration must not exceed 172.986 hours  
* Stage 10’s total handling duration must not exceed 201.341 hours  

Provided that every handling stage—Stage 1 through Stage 10—does not exceed its allotted time capacity, determine the optimal cargo allocation across the ten routes to maximize total revenue.
